methods.PPPM-original: Historical deconvolved influence, original cached near+far action
methods.B2-positive: Direct positive physical tensor table, positive assignment, no deconvolution
methods.PPPM-grid-PSD: Original influence, physical-table symmetric 3x3 negative-eigenvalue clipping, all resulting mesh modes

errors.E_G: ||Gamma_h-Gamma_D||_2 / ||Gamma_D||_2, complete dense symmetric spectral operator norm
errors.E_GX: Frobenius relative action error on the same ten historical Gaussian probes; supplementary, never feasibility criterion
errors.E_mesh: ||Gamma_Lh-(Gamma_D-Gamma_S(sR=8))||_2 / ||Gamma_D||_2; includes finite Fourier/table construction tail, negligible on fitted range
errors.E_G_mesh_only: Alias of E_mesh for new rows; imported historical original mesh-only used its truncated Fourier target, so dedicated convergence.csv is used for method-order comparisons
errors.E_proj: ||Gamma_gridPSD-Gamma_original||_2 / ||Gamma_D||_2; when the table projection is inactive, roundoff differences of assignment weights can remain
errors.E_original: Complete error before projection for the same requested numerical parameters
errors.norm_qualification: Float64 numerical spectral norms against independently certified direct references, not interval arithmetic certificates

cutoffs.sT: B2 kappa*R_T, physical image-cube half-width; not comparable by numerical equality with sF
cutoffs.post_projection: No cutoff or deconvolution is reapplied, actual zero mode retained

projection.min_raw_eig: Minimum physical real-space block eigenvalue after inversion symmetrization (raw-vs-sym difference separately audited)
projection.max_correction: Maximum spectral norm of an individual physical tensor correction
projection.correction_max_block_fro: Maximum block Frobenius norm, distinct from spectral correction
projection.neg_fraction: Fraction of blocks having any strictly negative float64 eigenvalue; no threshold is used to define the projection
projection.audit_eigenvalues_false: Production setup omits extra raw/post eigvalsh and quantiles; unmeasured fields are null. Operator bitwise equal to audited path.

timing.t_screen_s: Concurrent-load heuristic timing on uniform seed2, never the final speed comparison
timing.median_matvec_s: Median across nine per-configuration medians in the same serial timing pass; seconds
timing.protocol: 5 rounds x 7 samples x 9 configurations, randomized blocks, single numerical thread
timing.setup: Three fresh warmed-kernel parameter tables, three fresh configuration builds per state; parameter setup includes mandatory projection eigh, excludes optional table-audit eigvalsh
timing.memory: Unique owning ndarray allocations plus explicitly labeled temporary estimates; process RSS is a separate high-water measurement
timing.amortization: Measured T_table + T_config + n_apply*T_matvec; derived cost, not an additional measurement

fits.mesh_rate_fits: Last four decreasing points above floor, or at least three. Mixed projection-active transitions are formal finite-interval slopes, not asymptotic convergence certificates.
fits.mesh_local_slopes: Adjacent M slopes with projection regime and floor flags
fits.mesh_inactive_rate_fits: Only projection-inactive points above floor, at least three; otherwise N/A
